trainerx.name: TrainerX
trainerx.description: Adventure-map cheats and an object scanner; separate combat cheats and battlefield-terrain selection. F2/F3 have different actions on the adventure map and in combat. F6 opens additional adventure cheats.

1.name: Toggle object scanner
1.description: Enable or disable the scanner; right-click an object for its menu.

3.name: Execute ERM commands
3.description: Open ERM command input; documented in the Russian readme.

4.name: Repeat scanner action
4.description: While the object scanner is enabled, repeat its last action.

5.name: Scanner options
5.description: While the object scanner is enabled, change its options.

8.name: Reload ERA scripts
8.description: Reload scripts after enabling TrainerX during a game. The author recommends save/load if descriptions become incorrect.
